'''Pero Borgin''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Serenno/Legends|Serenno]]. He was the son of [[Cretia Borgin|Cretia Malvern]] and [[Rodas Borgin]], head of the [[House Borgin/Legends|House Borgin]] in the [[Standard year/Legends|years]] that followed the end of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Pero Borgin was rejected by his [[Parent/Legends|father]], who considered him with much disdain for being too sensitive and slightly overweight.<ref name="AOTE2" />

==Biography==
Following the death of his father, Pero Borgin was named the new Count Borgin and accepted his uncle, Count [[Orom Malvern]], as the new regent and [[Count of Serenno/Legends|Count of Serenno]].<ref name="AotE-HT5">[[Agent of the Empire – Hard Targets 5|''Agent of the Empire – Hard Targets'' 5]]</ref>
